title: Binary Mergers
description: Two compact stars in orbit radiate gravitational waves, spiral in, and merge in a final whoop of rising pitch. Their chirp mass sets how fast. Unlocks gravitational-wave echoes, and an answer from the Frontier.

puzzle.goal: Two masses m and n spiral together. Their gravitational waves depend on one combination of the two, which sets how fast the pitch rises. Write it, M.
puzzle.name: Chirp mass
puzzle.ask: Find M in solar masses for GW150914: m = @{m}, n = @{n}.
puzzle.method: The frequency rises as df/dt ∝ M^(5/3) f^(11/3) at leading order: only this combination enters.
